thread_text:
Maya Patel: Quick flag from recruiting ops: multiple interviewers are reporting inconsistent pass/fail outcomes for the same rubric this week. Looks like the guidance in the scorecard and the interviewer inline help differ.
Priya Desai: I saw a few notes from hiring managers asking why some interviewers put 'meets expectations' while others put 'strong no' for same criteria. Which panels?
Zoe Brooks: Panels 11111, 11112 across eng backend interviews. Recruiting forwarded 3 anonymized scorecards that disagree.
Samir Khan: I pulled the scorecard payloads from the importer. The scorecard has a field help_text_html and another help_markdown. The UI was rendering help_markdown for new panels but ATS still provided only help_text_html for older ones. That mismatch can show different wording.
Lena Ortiz: Oh — we shipped a tiny i18n conversion last week that prefers help_markdown over help_text_html. If ATS didn't include markdown the UI falls back but the rendered copy changed line breaks and examples. That would confuse interviewers.
Priya Desai: Can we revert rendering order quickly? We need consistent wording for today's calibration session.
Samir Khan: Short plan: 1) revert priority in renderer so help_text_html is used when markdown is missing (hotfix) 2) run a normalization job to populate help_markdown from help_text_html for legacy panels 3) update interviewer training note to call out formatting change and remind interviewers to use rubric examples not UI phrasing. I'll push a small canary change now.
Maya Patel: Also, recruiting ops asked why feedback left in the panel thread sometimes doesn't sync back to ATS candidate profile. Might be related?
Samir Khan: Good catch. There's a separate exporter job that maps internal feedback -> ats.feedback. It expects normalized help_markdown for parsing checkboxes and examples; when the help fields differ the exporter mis-parses and rejects the write with a 422. Example log: ERROR exporter: invalid_feedback_format expected_markdown_sections. So this renderer mismatch could explain both inconsistent scoring and failed syncs.
Zoe Brooks: Can we do the hotfix + a quick re-export for any failed candidate updates from last 24h? I can assemble a list.
Samir Khan: Yes. Hotfix to renderer pushed to canary. Once green I'll run re-exports for panels 11111/11112 and any candidate ids Zoe provides. Re-export command: `./tools/ats-export --since 24h --panel 11111,11112 --retry-failures`
Lena Ortiz: I'll coordinate with recruiting ops to pause the calibration session for 10m just to make sure everyone sees the same wording. Also adding a one-paragraph addendum to the interviewer guide explaining the change and asking interviewers to signal if wording looks off.
RecruitBot: created ticket R-2026-1234: "Scorecard help_text mismatch causing inconsistent scoring and export failures" assigned to Samir Khan due 2026-07-12
Maya Patel: Thanks. Zoe, please paste the candidate ids once you have them and Samir will re-run the export. Priya/Lena, please draft the short guide addendum and I'll share with hiring managers.
Samir Khan: Will follow up in this thread after re-export completes. Posting results then. :thumbsup:
